free_parameters.name: bsz
free_parameters.why: batch size 1 is the minimal batch that runs the target forward

free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: two query positions give a non-degenerate attention mask and KV length

free_parameters.name: hidden_size
free_parameters.why: small CPU-only hidden width exercising all four projections

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: two query heads exercise the KV-group expansion in the forward

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: small head width keeping the CPU fallback cheap

free_parameters.name: num_key_value_heads
free_parameters.why: GQA group count of one, matching the toy attention shape

free_parameters.name: starting_layer
free_parameters.why: layer 0 is below this, so the negative run takes the CPU fallback rather than a GPU kernel

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: deterministic projection weights and hidden states

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: default CPU floating dtype supported by the linear layers

free_parameters.name: unset_sentinel
free_parameters.why: input encoding for an unset layer index; the driver maps it to None, making the None boundary probeable with integer neighbours
